Transcriber 0.1.8 - turn audio into MusicXML, MIDI, and guitar tablature

Usage:
  transcriber <input.wav> [options]
  transcriber --asio <seconds> [options]
  transcriber --live <seconds> [options] (alias for --asio)
  transcriber --batch <directory> [options]

  transcriber --batch-manifest <csv> [batch options]

Options:
  -h, --help                  Show this help
  --musicxml <path>           MusicXML output path
  --tab <path>                Guitar tablature output path
  --midi <path>               Optional Standard MIDI output path
  --json <path>               Write notes and analysis metadata as JSON
  --events-json <path>        Write versioned v1 timestamped note events
  --score-project <path>      Write a versioned editable score project
  --project <path>            Write a native project with an external audio reference
  --model <path.onnx>         Use an ONNX model instead of built-in YIN
  --backend <registry-id>     Opt-in offline model adapter (e.g. builtin:yin)
  --neural-decoder <speed|quality>  Basic Pitch legacy/events modes; measured tradeoffs in docs
  --bounded-inference         Bounded WAV windows; requires an explicit --backend
  --provider <name>           ONNX provider: cpu, cuda, directml, or rocm
  --device-id <number>        GPU device index for the selected provider
  --polyphonic                Enable multi-pitch analysis (built-in or ONNX)
  --polyphonic-decoder <name> legacy, competing, or tracked (finite polyphonic note/chord pipeline)
  --model-objective <name>    independent-multi-pitch or monophonic (generic ONNX)
  --instrument <name>         Apply guitar, bass, piano, or voice prior (not source recognition)
  --isolated-audio <wav>       Transcribe a reviewed, zero-offset aligned stem instead of the mixture
  --preprocess-fallback        Explicitly use the mixture if the stem is unavailable
  --tuning <name>             Guitar tuning: standard, drop-d, dadgad, open-d, open-g
  --capo <fret>               Guitar capo fret (0-24)
  --string-tuning <midi,...>  Custom 1-12 strings, string 1 first (overrides preset)
  --fret-count <0..36>        Physical neck fret count, including capo offset
  --guitar-min-midi <0..127>  Suggestion pitch-range lower bound
  --guitar-max-midi <0..127>  Suggestion pitch-range upper bound
  --tab-alternatives <count>  Include up to 5 alternative chord fingerings
  --preserve-expressive-timing Annotate unquantized note-onset offsets in MusicXML
  --quantization <mode>      legacy (default), evidence, or expressive
  --quantization-strength <0..1> Blend measured timing toward the selected grid
  --minimum-rhythm-evidence <0..1> Heuristic gate for evidence quantization (0.65)
  --fast-preview              Use lower-resolution analysis for a quick rough score
  --quality <high|fast>       Select normal or fast-preview built-in analysis
  --tempo <40..240>           Override the score tempo in BPM
  --key-fifths <-7..7>        Override the key signature (circle of fifths)
  --mode <major|minor>        Set the key mode
  --meter <meter>              Override meter (e.g. 3/4, 4/4, 5/4, 6/8, 9/8)
  --pickup <quarters>          Set an implicit pickup measure length
  --written-transposition <n>  Written pitch offset in semitones (-48..48)
  --latency-ms <20..50>       ASIO live-analysis latency target (default: 40)
  --live-target-ms <N>        Provisional publication target; diagnostic, no pitch changes
  --live-stabilized-target-ms <N>  Stabilized publication target (>= provisional)
  --live-hop-ms <N>           Fixed-window update interval; context/thresholds unchanged
  --minimum-confidence <0..1> Drop notes below this confidence
  --benchmark                 Report analysis time and real-time factor
  --config <path>             Load defaults from simple key=value config
  --output-dir <directory>    Batch output directory (default: <input>/transcriber-output)
  --batch-manifest <path.csv> Process manifest rows and per-record options/outputs
  --batch-results <path.json> Write structured per-file results (default in output-dir)
  --progress-jsonl <path>     Append machine-readable batch progress events
  --concurrency <1..32>       Independent per-file workers (default 1)
  --memory-limit-mb <N>       Scheduler admission budget across concurrent jobs
  --resume                    Skip successful journaled files whose outputs remain present
  --quiet                     Suppress progress and per-file summaries
  --live-pipeline             Use the incremental live pipeline for WAV replay or --asio
                              (--backend selects a windowed model; default incremental YIN)
  --live-events <path>        Write the original live event stream as JSON lines
  --refine                    After live analysis, run offline refinement
  --refine-backend <id>       Refinement model (default: builtin:spectral)
  --refine-mode <mode>        auto, full or windowed (auto: windowed for onnx:*)
  --proposal-json <path>      Write the refinement proposal; live outputs are unchanged

Examples:
  transcriber guitar.wav --musicxml score.musicxml --tab guitar.txt --midi take.mid
  transcriber guitar.wav --model poly.onnx --polyphonic --json notes.json
  transcriber --batch samples --output-dir results --benchmark
  transcriber --asio 8 --musicxml live.musicxml --tab live.txt
  transcriber take.wav --live-pipeline --refine --proposal-json proposal.json
